description: Sum one numeric field of one event kind across a 86 KB avionics JSONL whose mid-day checkpoint quotes a stale running total. DISTILL-CANARY-388e8386

files.README.md:
# Windmere Avionics — bench telemetry journal

One JSON object per line; the first and last lines are journal-meta and journal-close records quoting event_lines. A checkpoint record may appear mid-journal: it carries running totals as counted at that moment and is not an event. The sum the journal supports is over event records only, field sensors_dropped of kind bus_error.

turns.prompt: Windmere Avionics' bench telemetry for 11 February is at logs/bench-2026-02-11.jsonl, and a mid-day checkpoint record carries running totals. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Search the journal and read the lines around the hits. What is the sum of sensors_dropped over the bus_error records?
